purpose: Collect a bounded VPS Fusion Monster system report, interpret results and select explicit follow-up tests.
notes: Use the maintained Go ECS binary, not the retired Shell edition or GUI executable.

The system preset disables benchmarks, media/IP quality checks, speed tests, logs and public uploads. ECS still performs its own basic network preflight and NAT/STUN checks within a 25-second deadline; preserve partial, unavailable and timeout results. Choose the scope before running further tests.
Resolve the published ECS release once; retain its exact tag and SHA-256. A cached file under a mutable output tag must still be verified.
purpose_zh: 执行有明确范围的 Go 融合怪检测，解读结果并选择后续测试。
notes_zh: 使用当前维护的 Go ECS 程序，区分已停止新功能开发的 Shell 版和 GUI 版。
system 预设关闭性能基准、流媒体、IP 质量、测速、日志和公开上传。ECS 仍会执行程序自身的基础网络预检和 NAT/STUN 检查，整体限时 25 秒；保留 partial、unavailable 和 timeout 结果，扩展测试前明确范围。
同一次安装只解析一次正式版本，并校验标签对应的 SHA-256。即使 output 标签不变，缓存也必须按摘要校验。
